UNIVER-PRESETS-CORE-BRIDGE — THIRD-PARTY LICENCE TEXTS
=========================================================

src/univer-shared/vendor/univer-presets-core-bridge.js is the checked-in UMD build of the
univer-presets bridge (upstream: the univer-presets project; built for this repo, sha256
c92ce24933286b9a…). It embeds the libraries below. MIT requires their copyright and
permission notices to accompany copies, so they ship here, next to the code.

React and RxJS are also embedded/referenced by the bridge; their licence texts ship next to
the other vendored workbench libraries as REACT-LICENSE.txt and RXJS-LICENSE.txt (react-is and
prop-types are Facebook MIT code covered by that same REACT-LICENSE.txt text). Univer's own
Apache-2.0 text ships as UNIVER-LICENSE.txt beside this file.
